# The Gourmet Gifts
> B2B corporate gifting company based in Mumbai, India. We curate bespoke,
> artisanal gift hampers for employees, clients, partners and events —
> not a fixed catalogue, but gifts built around who you're gifting to.

## Company
- Legal name: House of Satra Pvt Ltd
- Location: Mumbai, India
- Contact: hello@thegourmetgifts.co

## Key Pages
- [Occasions](https://thegourmetgifts.co/occasions): Employee, client, festive, events, milestone, dealer/partner, celebration and CX gifting.
- [Catalogue](https://thegourmetgifts.co/collections): Gourmet food, beverages, decor, wellness, stationery, apparel, electronics and recognition items.
- [Contact](https://thegourmetgifts.co/contact): Submit a corporate gifting brief.
